claim: The repo identifies the engine as Monolith LithTech lineage ('Kraken' ClientShell) with a data-driven Scaleform (GFx) front-end UI and a global StringDatabase localization function.
evidence: GameOffsets.h:80 "--- Front-end / start menu (LithTech \"Kraken\" ClientShell) ---"; :166 "The front-end IS Scaleform (GFxValue)."
game_build_compatibility: UNKNOWN: repo records no game version, Steam buildid, exe hash or build check; it only states a ~112 MB x64 Steam exe with SteamStub v3.1 + Denuvo (docs/reverse-engineering.md:12,21-29). Our exe is 117732784 bytes (~112.3 MiB), consistent but not proof of 1.0.8874.0 / build 3095001. Our projectconsole.cfg uses 'GameClientShell.' prefixed vars, which is consistent with a ClientShell architecture.
verification_method: Static read. Verify by string search in our exe/data for CUIFrontEndRootLayer, GFx/Scaleform, StringDatabase strings (read-only).
limitations: Engine naming is the author's inference from strings/RTTI.
next_experiment: Read-only string/RTTI scan of our exe for 'Kraken', 'GameClientShell', 'GFx' and '.?AV' class names to seed the object model.
